page: OVHcloud c3-8-flex is a compute-optimized virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 4 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading (1 thread per core), eliminating hyper-threading contention. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB, yielding a compute-aligned ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The CPU configuration features 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AES, SHA-NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, though AVX-512 extensions are absent.

Storage consists of a bundled 50 GB local NVMe SSD, delivering fast local read and write operations directly attached to the instance. The instance includes no GPU acceleration hardware. On the network side, the baseline throughput is reported at 0 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, which may necessitate separate network or IP provisioning depending on deployment needs.

Benchmark data displays solid single-threaded performance, with stress-ng single-core throughput ranking in the top 25% at 3078.08, complemented by a Geekbench text processing score of 2564.0. Multi-core operations remain within the middle 50% tier, registering 12259.62 in stress-ng and 5989.0 in Geekbench multi-core. Cryptographic and memory operations are balanced, showing 32.82 GB/sec uncached large-block memory writes and a PassMark CPU score of 10645.63. However, static web serving throughput measures lower at 4.86 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 25%, alongside lower prompt processing on 7B parameter models.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio combined with dedicated physical cores offers stable compute density without paying for unused memory allocations. OVHcloud c3-8-flex is well structured for CPU-bound utility services, batch data processing, continuous integration compilation runners, text processing pipelines, and internal microservices that require dedicated CPU time alongside fast local NVMe storage.
